requirements.quote: CONDUIT BELOW GRADE TO BE NON-METALLIC AND CONCRETE ENCASED.
requirements.text: Underground conduits must be non-metallic and encased in concrete.

requirements.quote: PROVIDE NEW CONDUIT DUCT BANK CONSISTING OF (4) 4" CONDUITS. CONNECT TO EXISTING CONDUIT
requirements.text: Install a new duct bank with four 4-inch conduits and connect to existing conduit.

requirements.quote: PROVIDE (2) 4" CONDUITS FOR POWER CONNECTION FROM SWITCHGEAR IN SWITCHGEAR BUILDING TO LOCATION INDICATED AND STUB & CAP CONDUITS FOR CONNECTION IN FUTURE PHASE.
requirements.text: Install two 4-inch conduits for power from switchgear to specified location, stub and cap for future use.

requirements.quote: PROVIDE (2) 2" CONDUITS FOR DATA CONNECTION FROM MDF IN SWITCHGEAR BUILDING TO LOCATION INDICATED AND STUB & CAP CONDUITS FOR CONNECTION IN FUTURE PHASE.
requirements.text: Install two 2-inch conduits for data from MDF to specified location, stub and cap for future use.

requirements.quote: PROVIDE (2) 2" CONDUITS FOR FIRE ALARM CONNECTION FROM FACU IN SWITCHGEAR BUILDING TO LOCATION INDICATED AND STUB & CAP CONDUITS FOR CONNECTION IN FUTURE PHASE.
requirements.text: Install two 2-inch conduits for fire alarm from FACU to specified location, stub and cap for future use.
